description_en: An asynchronous API to access the large language model capabilities of DAS
description_zh: DAS大模型能力异步逻辑接口
kebab_example: aliyun das chat --message id_:_68fe0321-37fe-4c75-a118-b61b33156f6a_,_role_:_user_,_content_:_type_:_text_,_text_:_hello --session-id 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-xxxxxxxxxxxx --agent-id ag-472T0DxtmjIxxxxx --summary false --region cn-hangzhou
name: Chat

parameters.description_en: Optional. The session ID, which must be a UUID. If unspecified, a new session is created. To maintain conversational context, use the same session ID for all subsequent requests.
parameters.description_zh: 可选，会话 ID，格式为 UUID 字符串。如未指定默认创建新的会话。上下文对话需保持同一个会话 ID。
parameters.help_en: Optional. The session ID, which must be a UUID. If unspecified, a new session is created. To maintain conversational context, use the same session ID for all subsequent requests

parameters.name: session_id

parameters.description_en: Optional. The agent ID. You can use the ID of an agent that is automatically generated when you enable DAS Agent, or the ID of a custom agent. If this parameter is omitted, the default agent is used.
parameters.description_zh: 可选，用于服务的 Agent ID。可指定为开启 DAS Agent 后生成的Agent 或主动创建的 Agent。如未指定则使用默认 Agent 进行服务。
